svg.title: CIFAR-10's first training image, a frog, padded by 4 pixels of the average colour, and four crops and mirror images crop_flip made of it (the mean of the three channels drawn)
svg.text: what four passes see: a new crop, mirrored half the time
The dashed squares are the four windows on the padded image. A window that starts at its top left shows the picture moved
4 pixels down and right; where the window passes the edge, the padding comes in.
